win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: MULTIPLIERS GONE WILD
wilds.behavior:
Multiplier symbols are Wild and substitute for any symbol in the paytable. They also multiply the value of all Cash symbols in a 3x3 area around them if you land a Grab’em symbol!

 Multiplier values are applied to any winning payline they are part of. If more than one Multiplier is part of the same payline, their values are multiplied by each other before being applied to the payline.

 The possible Multiplier values are: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x15, x20, x25.

 Multiplier symbols with a value of x5 or higher land with a ? and reveal their value when Cash is collected.

scatters.name: CASH MONEY
scatters.behavior:
Land, collect, multiply!

 Cash symbols award a prize when collected! Cash symbols can display a value from one of the following: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

 Cash symbols are collected if a Grab’em scatter symbol appears at the same time as at least one Cash symbol.

 Multiplier symbols affect all collected Cash in a 3x3 area around the symbol. If more than one Multiplier lands adjacent to a Cash symbol, the Cash value is multiplied by each adjacent Multiplier symbol.

scatters.name: THE VAULT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 6 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus feature offers an enhanced base game experience, with better odds of landing a greater number of Cash and Multiplier symbols with higher values!

 On top of that, all landed Multiplier symbol positions are activated for the duration of the feature! That means that a random multiplier will land on every remaining spin on all activated positions.

 Landing the Stopwatch symbol awards 2 to 6 additional free spins, indicated by the number shown on the stopwatch display.

scatters.name: THE HIGH-SECURITY VAULT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 9 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus feature offers an enhanced base game experience, with better odds of landing a greater number of Cash and Multiplier symbols with higher values!

 All landed Cash symbols will have a minimum value of 5x!

 On top of that, all landed Multiplier symbol positions are activated for the duration of the feature! That means that a random multiplier will land on every remaining spin on all activated positions.

 Landing the Stopwatch symbol awards 2 to 6 additional free spins, indicated by the number shown on the stopwatch display.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Multiplier symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.
